:WISDOM LIVES HERE "👋 ‼️ 

"THE FREE STUFF TRAP"
... A "Selfish Person" Provides Meals To Catch Our Eyes, BUT It Will Dull Our Senses‼️

🩵 PROVERBS 23:6-8 (NASB)...
(V6) " Do Not Eat the Bread of a Selfish Man, Or Desire His Delicacies;
(V6) For as He Thinks Within Himself,  So He Is. He Says to You, 
"Eat and Drink !" ...
BUT His Heart IS Not with You.
(V8) You WILL Vomit Up  the Morsel You have Eaten,
AND Waste Your Compliments  "... AMEN❗️

This Passage  WARNS ...
◾️Against  Accepting  Hospitality from "Stingy, Selfish  Miser", Who has Ulterior Motives.
◾️Advise that It Is Better to Stay away from the Company of Deceitful People. It Is a Trap Rather than Genuine Kindness ❗️

✅️ BREAKING IT DOWN...
V6... AVOID STINGY HOST :-
Solomon  Warns Not to eat the food of a Miser. They may offer food, But it us a Trap to put You in Their Debt. 

V7... INSINCERE INTENTION :-
While They maybe saying, "Eat and Drink", with a smiling face, They are secretly Calculating  the cost and Expecting some thing in return. 🤔

V8... THE REGRET :-
Eventually, the Feeling of Nausea You Experience  when You Realized You have been Manipulated  makes You want to "Vomit Up the food You have just eaten" ❗️
AND...
Any "Sweet Words" Or "Compliments" You offer in return will be a Complete "Waste  of Time", because  the Host's (the Miser's)  heart is hard... A Hidden Agenda was there from the beginning ❗️

🤔WHY WOULD THIS MAN DO THIS?
▪︎Greed and Selfishness 
▪︎Offering to get something in return
▪︎An attempt to buy someone's favor 

🤔 NB...The Cost in The End makes You Feel  like a Complete Idiot and You will "Kick" Yourself for ever accepting  the Invitation for Lunch or Dinner. 

✅️ LEARN...
▪︎ There is no Free Lunch with a Manipulative Person. Their hospitality is used as leverage to control or buy Your favor.
▪︎True generosity comes from a Joyful Sincere Heart. A simple meal shared is better than "Lavish Feast" (Delicacies)
▪︎ An Excellent lesson in Setting Boundaries and Being Discerning about Who You allow unto Your " Inner Circle" ❗️❗️❗️

⚠️ GOD WARNS US TO STAY AWAY AND NOT TO BE DRAWN IN BY THE DELICACIES OF SELFISH PEOPLE. 

AMEN⁉️

More Next Month on This Chapter 😉 
#Godisgood #GloryToGod #JesusIsLord #thewordofGodispowerful #TheWordOfGodIsAlive #JesusIsComingSoon #judgment #evangelistpauline 💞

@7up by @wearedeutsch 7UP is undergoing its biggest U.S. brand evolution in more than 15 years, introducing a new lime-forward formula alongside a refreshed visual identity. The challenge was to modernise one of the category’s most recognisable soft drink brands while creating a stronger visual presence around its renewed citrus proposition. The identity streamlines the familiar 7UP logo into an all-caps lockup with a consistent baseline and visual height, supported by richer colours and a prominent Lime Lemon label. Developed in-house by Keurig Dr Pepper with Deutsch, the system gives 7UP a bolder, more contemporary expression while reinforcing its distinctive citrus character.

#branding #creativedirector #brandinginspiration #brandcuration #designfinder
